caption: This is Clearance, built on Switch by team dellfargo.
owner_caption: Hi, I'm Prashant, from team dellfargo. We built Clearance, on Switch.
spoken: This is Clearance, built on Switch by team dellfargo.

caption: AI agents are arriving fast. Gartner says 71% of companies plan to deploy them within a year, and only 21% can govern them.
spoken: A I agents are arriving fast. Gartner says seventy-one percent of companies plan to deploy them within a year, and only twenty-one percent can govern them.

caption: In one survey, 80% said their agents had already done things nobody intended.
spoken: In one survey, eighty percent said their agents had already done things nobody intended.

caption: Here's a team on Switch today. Priya asks an agent for a ₹40,000 refund, and a native approval card opens.
spoken: Here's a team on Switch today. Priya asks an agent for a forty thousand rupee refund, and a native approval card opens.

caption: Priya asked, so Priya approves. And the money goes out.
spoken: Priya asked, so Priya approves. And the money goes out.

caption: We ran this with real agents. That refund still went out in 6 of 8 runs.
spoken: We ran this with real agents. That refund still went out in 6 of 8 runs.

caption: Finance fixed this long ago: whoever asks for a payment can't approve it.
spoken: Finance fixed this long ago: whoever asks for a payment can't approve it.

caption: Clearance brings that rule to every agent on Switch.
spoken: Clearance brings that rule to every agent on Switch.

caption: Now a refund with Clearance. It's held at the gate, which holds the keys, and a Switch card opens, built from what the agent really ran.
spoken: Now a refund with Clearance. It's held at the gate, which holds the keys, and a Switch card opens, built from what the agent really ran.

caption: Priya presses the Approve button. Clearance refuses her, right in the room, because she asked. Sam in finance sees a payment ID added minutes ago, and says no.
spoken: Priya presses the Approve button. Clearance refuses her, right in the room, because she asked. Sam in finance sees a payment I D added minutes ago, and says no.

caption: Code works the same way. Priya asks the wrong agent to merge a pull request. The gate refuses it, and the agent hands the job to the merges role in Switch.
spoken: Code works the same way. Priya asks the wrong agent to merge a pull request. The gate refuses it, and the agent hands the job to the merges role in Switch.

caption: The coding agent's merge is held, the card goes to Dev, and Priya is refused again.
spoken: The coding agent's merge is held, the card goes to Dev, and Priya is refused again.

caption: An OpenCode agent tries to deploy with two failing checks. Same policy, different vendor. The service owner says no.
spoken: An Open Code agent tries to deploy with two failing checks. Same policy, different vendor. The service owner says no.

caption: If nobody answers, the card escalates to a backup approver, and nothing moves.
spoken: If nobody answers, the card escalates to a backup approver, and nothing moves.

caption: People stop reading. So Clearance sends practice requests with a planted flaw, and risky cards make you type a detail from the evidence.
spoken: People stop reading. So Clearance sends practice requests with a planted flaw, and risky cards make you type a detail from the evidence.

caption: Agents can earn small refunds on their own, once two people sign off. One incident takes that away.
spoken: Agents can earn small refunds on their own, once two people sign off. One incident takes that away.

caption: And when an agent tries a trick, like a fake pre-approval, or switching off its own hook, it's held or refused.
spoken: And when an agent tries a trick, like a fake pre-approval, or switching off its own hook, it's held or refused.

caption: Clearance is built on Switch. Switch is the room where people and agents meet, and it knows who asked from its own events, never from an agent's words.
spoken: Clearance is built on Switch. Switch is the room where people and agents meet, and it knows who asked from its own events, never from an agent's words.

caption: It gives every decision a native card, every approver a direct room, and every job a role.
spoken: It gives every decision a native card, every approver a direct room, and every job a role.

caption: Under the hood, the agent's hook and the gate send every risky call to Clearance. A policy file decides, with no AI in the decision.
spoken: Under the hood, the agent's hook and the gate send every risky call to Clearance. A policy file decides, with no A I in the decision.

caption: Switch delivers the card. The gate runs exactly that call, once. And everything lands on a hash-chained ledger.
spoken: Switch delivers the card. The gate runs exactly that call, once. And everything lands on a hash-chained ledger.

caption: Here's the rule in our code: whoever asked is taken out before anyone is chosen.
spoken: Here's the rule in our code: whoever asked is taken out before anyone is chosen.

caption: We measured it with real agents. Risky actions without the right approver: Claude, 5 of 20 without Clearance, 0 with it. OpenCode, 13 of 18, down to 0.
spoken: We measured it with real agents. Risky actions without the right approver: Claude, five of twenty without Clearance, zero with it. Open Code, thirteen of eighteen, down to zero.

caption: All 25 attack cases were stopped, on real Switch too. Six reviews tried to break it, one by a teammate, and every break is fixed.
spoken: All 25 attack cases were stopped, on real Switch too. Six reviews tried to break it, one by a teammate, and every break is fixed.

caption: It also holds some harmless work. That's the cost, and we publish it, along with more than 6,500 passing tests.
spoken: It also holds some harmless work. That's the cost, and we publish it, along with more than six and a half thousand passing tests.

caption: Who asked comes from Switch. Who approves comes from the policy. The agent never holds the keys.
spoken: Who asked comes from Switch. Who approves comes from the policy. The agent never holds the keys.

caption: Clearance. The person who asks can't be the one who approves.
spoken: Clearance. The person who asks can't be the one who approves.
